inputs.newline_note: CRCRLF is accepted and normalized for parsing without altering the hashed source bytes.
inputs.scope: Publisher table containing parent-ligand SMILES and SMARCA2/SMARCA4 IC50 values plus degrader rows.
Source binding graphs identifying the SMARCA2 and SMARCA4 assays as TR-FRET. Buffer and temperature are not inferred.

inputs.source_url_binding: The caller must supply the verified publication or supplementary-note URL with --route-url; this metadata does not invent one.
inputs.scope: Original reported routes only. Generated CRBN, SAR, or linker candidates require a new route assessment.
Connectivity and represented stereochemistry are reported separately; unspecified CSV stereochemistry and possible atropisomerism are not silently resolved.

outputs.directory_requirement: --output must identify a path that does not already exist.
outputs.immutability: Output content is hash-manifested and files are made read-only after an atomic directory move.
